prices: End-of-day closes from Nasdaq (daily candles). Not real-time and not a delayed quote.

weights.label: Weekly trend agrees
weights.rule: The last completed weekly close is above a rising 50-week average.

weights.label: Daily trend and structure
weights.rule: Price is above a rising 50-day average, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

weights.label: Strong relative strength
weights.rule: Relative strength rank is 70 or higher (1 to 99, against every stock the site screens).

weights.label: Relative strength improving
weights.rule: The rank is at least 5 points higher than 21 sessions ago.

weights.label: Volume supports the setup
weights.rule: Volume on up days is at least 1.2 times volume on down days over 20 sessions, or today is an up day on 1.5 times normal volume.

weights.label: Reward is at least twice the risk
weights.rule: The first target is at least 2 times as far from the entry as the stop is.

weights.label: Not stretched
weights.rule: Price is no more than 1.5 ATRs above the 21 EMA.

weights.label: Momentum healthy
weights.rule: RSI is between 40 and 70, and the MACD histogram is above zero or rising.

weights.label: Bollinger Bands agree
weights.rule: Pullbacks, reversals and momentum: price is no more than 80% of the way up the bands. Breakouts: the bands were narrow (lowest quarter of 120 sessions) in the 20 sessions before.

weights.label: No earnings soon
weights.rule: The next earnings date is known to be at least 15 weekdays away, or the calendar shows none in the next 60 weekdays.

weights.label: Market trend supportive
weights.rule: The S&P 500 ETF is above its 200-day average with the 50-day above the 200-day.
